description: This file is a JavaScript module providing a minimal API client for a dashboard frontend. It includes functions to construct API URLs, fetch domain state data asynchronously, and handle API responses and errors. This module facilitates interaction with backend API endpoints for fetching application state information.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for API requests based on environment variables, removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL and a path into a complete URL, handling slashes appropriately.

methods.name: fetchJson(url, { timeoutMs = 8000 } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to fetch JSON data from a URL with a timeout. Handles success, failure, and timeout errors.

methods.name: fetchDomainStateFromApi()
methods.description: Main exported async function that attempts to fetch domain state data from configured API endpoints, handling fallback and error cases.
